meta_description: Dubai hot air balloon rides from €234 to €419 compared: flight time, pickup, breakfast, camel and falcon add-ons, and which sunrise flight is worth booking.

lead: Book the €271 sunrise flight with camel ride and Bedouin breakfast if this is your first balloon ride in Dubai. It is the same 40–70 minute, 4,000 ft flight as the €249 flight-only tour, plus a camp breakfast, a camel ride and falcon photos for €22 more.

Marking an occasion? The €419 luxury flight caps the balloon at 16 guests, collects you in a private-group Land Rover and ends with a breakfast menu by a Michelin-starred chef inside a nature reserve. On a tight budget, the best-reviewed flight-only option is €249.

The flight barely decides it: every option here launches over the desert at sunrise with hotel pickup. What differs is what happens after landing, the air time each operator promises, the pickup zone and the extras outside the from-price, like a 450 AED flight video.
Below: 7 balloon flights side by side, a price-per-minute table, and the pickup times and age and weight limits that catch people out.

review: This is the flight plus a proper morning in the desert, and it is the package to book first time. You get the standard 40–70 minute sunrise flight at around 4,000 ft, then a buffet breakfast at a Bedouin camp, a short camel ride and photos with a falcon, all inside a 5-hour trip with hotel pickup.

The comparison that matters is with #2, the flight-only tour that uses the same Margham launch area and lists the same 40–70 minute air time. That one costs €249.38, this one €271.14. The breakfast, camel and falcon cost you about €22 together. For anyone who wants to eat after a pre-dawn start, this is the better buy.

The cheaper breakfast-and-camel package (#7) undercuts it by €25, but it carries a 3.9 rating against 4.75 here across more than ten times as many reviews. That gap is worth €25 on a morning you only do once.
Catches: the full flight video costs 450 AED, there is no pickup from Jebel Ali or Bab Al Shams, and guests over 120 kg or over 80 cannot fly. Children under 5 are not allowed.

review: This is the upgrade, and it is a real one. It is the only flight here that caps the balloon at 16 guests, picks you up as a private group in a Land Rover Defender (up to 6 per car) and finishes with a private breakfast by a Michelin-starred chef inside the grounds of a Royal Nature Reserve. A short camel ride around the oasis is included.

The flight itself is about 1 hour at up to 4,000 ft, so in the air you get roughly what the €249 tour gives you. The €169 difference pays for the smaller basket, the private car and the breakfast. Against #1, which already includes a camp breakfast and camel ride, the gap is €147.
It is the top-rated option here at 4.85 across 408 reviews. For a once-in-a-trip occasion that rating, plus not sharing a car with strangers before dawn, is what you are buying.

Practical catches: children under 7 cannot join (most other flights allow 5+), guiding is English only, and UAE rules mean you send each guest's passport or Emirates ID number, nationality, full name, email, mobile and date of birth before the flight.

guide.h2: Pickup Time, Season, What to Bring and What Costs Extra
guide.html:
Pickup is in the middle of the night. Work back from the itineraries: about 45–50 minutes of driving to the launch site, then 50–60 minutes of coffee, briefing and inflation before take-off at sunrise. Expect your pickup roughly two hours before sunrise; the operator confirms the exact time. Go to bed early and skip the late night out.

Weather sets the flight length. Every operator ties the air time to the conditions on the day (40–70 minutes is the usual range), so treat the longer end as a bonus, not a promise. All seven offer free cancellation up to 24 hours before, which leaves room to move your date if the forecast looks wrong.

Who cannot fly: children under 5 (under 7 on the luxury flight), pregnant women and people with back problems on every flight. Four flights also exclude guests over 120 kg, and four exclude guests over 80.

What to bring: passport or ID (a copy is usually accepted), comfortable shoes, sunglasses, a hat and a warm layer for the pre-dawn wait. Backpacks, large bags, drones and baby strollers are not allowed on most flights. For the luxury flight you submit passport or Emirates ID details for every guest in advance, as UAE rules require.

What costs extra: the full flight video (450 AED on #1, optional on #4 and #6), tips, and pickup outside the standard zones. Jebel Ali and Bab Al Shams are excluded on #1 and #2, and private-only on #7.

faqs.q: How much is a hot air balloon ride in Dubai?
faqs.a: Sunrise flights with hotel pickup cost from €234 to €419 per person. Most sit between €246 and €284. Flight-only starts at €234 (Noble Life) or €249 for the better-reviewed tour; with breakfast and a camel ride from €246, or €271 for the top-rated combo. The luxury flight with a Michelin-chef breakfast is €419.

faqs.q: How long is a hot air balloon flight in Dubai?
faqs.a: Usually 40–70 minutes in the air, depending on the weather. One package lists 60–90 minutes and the luxury flight about 1 hour. With pickup, briefing and the drive back, the whole trip takes 4–5 hours.

faqs.q: What time is pickup for a Dubai balloon ride?
faqs.a: Very early. With a 45–50 minute drive and about an hour of coffee and briefing before a sunrise take-off, pickup is roughly two hours before sunrise. The operator confirms the exact time before your flight.
Only on some. #1 and #7 include a Bedouin camp buffet, #3 a Michelin-chef breakfast, and #5 in its deluxe and premium tiers. The flight-only options serve tea or coffee before take-off.

faqs.q: Can children go on a hot air balloon in Dubai?
faqs.a: Yes, from age 5 on most flights and from 7 on the luxury flight. Baby strollers are not allowed on most of them.
Four of the seven flights do not take guests over 120 kg (#1, #2, #5 and #7). If this applies to you, pick #3, #4 or #6 and confirm with the operator before booking.

Do the balloon for a calm sunrise view from 4,000 ft. Do an evening safari for dune bashing and dinner in the desert. They work well on different days; compare options in our desert safari comparison.

methodology: We compared 7 sunrise hot air balloon flights from Dubai side by side on live listing prices for a normal date: price, listed air time, total trip length, pickup zone, breakfast, camel, falcon and other add-ons, group set-up, age and weight limits, and guest ratings. Price per air minute uses each flight's shortest stated air time. Rankings weigh what the price buys after landing against the operator's rating history.
